entities.summary: Logan Miles Woodside is an American professional football quarterback. He played college football for the Toledo Rockets and was selected by the Cincinnati Bengals in the seventh round of the 2018 NFL draft. Woodside was also previously a member of the Tennessee Titans, Atlanta Falcons, and Pittsburgh Steelers, as well as the San Antonio Commanders of the Alliance of American Football (AAF).
